sentence:
For triangle-free graphs (i.e., $K_3$-free), the **maximum** number of edges is: $$
\left\lfloor \frac{n^2}{4} \right\rfloor
$$

For $n = 10$, this is: $$
\left\lfloor \frac{10^2}{4} \right\rfloor = \left\lfloor \frac{100}{4} \right\rfloor = 25
$$
